meaning.en: To lay ambushes on all sides so the enemy cannot escape.
meaning.zh: 四面八方都设下伏兵，使敌人无处可逃。

examples.zh: 对方在山谷里十面埋伏，我军陷入重围。
examples.en: The enemy set ambushes all round the valley and our army was surrounded.

examples.zh: 这场比赛对手布下十面埋伏，我们寸步难行。
examples.en: The opposition closed us down from every angle and we could hardly move.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; also a famous pipa piece.
usage.zh: 可作谓语、定语；也是著名琵琶曲名。

meaning.en: Always eager to outdo others and win.
meaning.zh: 处处要强，喜欢胜过别人。

examples.zh: 他从小争强好胜，什么都想拿第一。
examples.en: He has been fiercely competitive since childhood and wants to come first at everything.

examples.zh: 争强好胜的人往往不太懂得示弱。
examples.en: Those who always need to win seldom know how to back down.

meaning.en: Not to blame someone for past mistakes.
meaning.zh: 对过去的错误不再责备追究。

examples.zh: 只要你改正错误，大家既往不咎。
examples.en: As long as you put it right, we'll let bygones be bygones.

examples.zh: 公司对主动坦白者既往不咎。
examples.en: The company will not pursue those who come forward voluntarily.

story.en: Confucius: 'What is done is done; what is past, do not blame' (成事不说，遂事不谏，既往不咎).
story.zh: 《论语》：“成事不说，遂事不谏，既往不咎。”

usage.en: Predicate; common in notices and policy.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常见于告示、政策。

meaning.en: To do something piecemeal, in small stages rather than all at once.
meaning.zh: 一点一点地做，不一次完成。

examples.zh: 这个工程是零敲碎打干成的。
examples.en: The project was finished bit by bit.

examples.zh: 他靠零敲碎打的积累，慢慢还清了债。
examples.en: By saving little by little, he gradually cleared his debts.

meaning.en: Each side tries to cheat and outwit the other.
meaning.zh: 互相欺骗，互相提防。

equivalents: each trying to deceive the other

examples.zh: 商场上尔虞我诈，很难找到真心朋友。
examples.en: With so much double-dealing in business, true friends are hard to find.

examples.zh: 两国之间长期尔虞我诈，互不信任。
examples.en: The two states have long deceived each other and trust no one.

story.en: Treaty words of Chu and Song: 'I do not cheat you, you do not deceive me' (我无尔诈，尔无我虞).

meaning.en: To love what is new and tire of what is old, in people or things.
meaning.zh: 喜爱新的，厌弃旧的，多指爱情不专一。

equivalents: drop the old for the new

examples.zh: 他喜新厌旧，刚买的手机又想换。
examples.en: He's always after something new and already wants to swap his just-bought phone.

examples.zh: 她最恨喜新厌旧的人。
examples.en: She despises people who drop old loves for new ones.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; can be about love or possessions.
usage.zh: 作谓语、定语，可指爱情或物品。

literal: oneself · look after · not · have time

meaning.en: So caught up in one's own troubles that there is no time to help others.
meaning.zh: 连照顾自己都来不及，哪有余力管别人。

equivalents: have troubles enough of one's own

examples.zh: 我现在自顾不暇，实在帮不了你。
examples.en: I can barely cope myself right now, so I really can't help you.

examples.zh: 公司自顾不暇，哪还有心思扶持别人。
examples.en: The firm is struggling to stay afloat and has no energy to support others.

meaning.en: To gain good fortune as a result of a misfortune.
meaning.zh: 因为遭受了灾祸，反而得到了好处。

examples.zh: 没考上那所学校，他因祸得福，进了更好的专业。
examples.en: Missing that school turned out well, as he got into a better course.

examples.zh: 这次受伤让他戒了烟，也算因祸得福。
examples.en: The injury made him quit smoking, so it was a blessing in disguise.

antonyms: 搬起石头砸自己的脚——自作自受

meaning.en: This is a matter of great importance.
meaning.zh: 这件事关系重大，不可轻视。

examples.zh: 兹事体大，务必慎重处理。
examples.en: This is a weighty matter and must be handled with great care.

examples.zh: 合并事宜兹事体大，须董事会批准。
examples.en: The merger is of great consequence and needs board approval.

usage.zh: 作谓语，书面语，略带文言色彩。

meaning.en: So many examples that they cannot all be listed.
meaning.zh: 形容例子极多，列举不完。

examples.zh: 这样的例子举不胜举。
examples.en: Examples like this are too many to list.

examples.zh: 历史上以弱胜强的战役举不胜举。
examples.en: Battles in which the weak beat the strong are countless.

usage.en: Predicate; often after 例子/事例.

meaning.en: Things outside oneself, such as wealth and status, that are not essential to life.
meaning.zh: 自己身体以外的东西，多指钱财、地位等。

examples.zh: 金钱不过是身外之物。
examples.en: Money is no more than worldly goods.

examples.zh: 他视名利为身外之物，一心做学问。
examples.en: He treats fame and gain as incidental and devotes himself to scholarship.

usage.en: Often 视…为身外之物 or 不过是身外之物.

meaning.en: Alone, without family or support, and living in hardship.
meaning.zh: 孤独困苦，无依无靠。

examples.zh: 老人孤苦伶仃，全靠邻居照顾。
examples.en: The old man is all alone and relies on his neighbours.

examples.zh: 父母去世后，他孤苦伶仃地长大。
examples.en: After his parents died he grew up alone and in want.

synonyms: 外无期功强近之亲，内无应门五尺之僮，茕茕孑立，形影相吊

meaning.en: Straightforward and quick to say what one thinks.
meaning.zh: 性格直爽，想到什么就说什么。

examples.zh: 她心直口快，说话从不拐弯抹角。
examples.en: She's outspoken and never beats about the bush.

examples.zh: 我这人心直口快，有得罪的地方请原谅。
examples.en: I tend to speak my mind, so forgive me if I offend.

usage.zh: 作谓语，常用来为自己直言辩解。

synonyms: 一根肠子通到底——直性子
antonyms: 铁拐李的葫芦——不知卖的啥药

meaning.en: Closely bound together, like flesh and blood.
meaning.zh: 像血和肉一样紧密相连，关系极为密切。

examples.zh: 军队和人民血肉相连。
examples.en: The army and the people are as one.

examples.zh: 海峡两岸同胞血肉相连。
examples.en: Compatriots across the Strait are bound by blood.

usage.en: Predicate; often in political or patriotic contexts.
usage.zh: 作谓语，多见于政治、爱国语境。

meaning.en: The age of forty.
meaning.zh: 指四十岁。

examples.zh: 他已步入不惑之年，事业稳定。
examples.en: He has reached forty and his career is stable.

examples.zh: 不惑之年的她开始学习绘画。
examples.en: At forty she began to learn painting.

story.en: Confucius, on his life stages: 'At forty I had no doubts' (四十而不惑).
story.zh: 《论语》：“吾十有五而志于学，三十而立，四十而不惑。”

literal: drive · to the end · kill · wipe out

meaning.en: To destroy completely, leaving no way out.
meaning.zh: 一个不留地彻底消灭，比喻手段极其狠毒。

examples.zh: 他们对竞争对手赶尽杀绝。
examples.en: They showed their rivals no mercy.

examples.zh: 做人不要太绝，别把人赶尽杀绝。
examples.en: Don't be so ruthless as to leave others no way out.

antonyms: 凡事留一线，日后好相见

meaning.en: Countless difficulties and dangers.
meaning.zh: 形容困难和危险极多。

examples.zh: 探险队克服千难万险，登上了峰顶。
examples.en: The expedition overcame every hardship and reached the summit.

examples.zh: 无论千难万险，我们都要完成任务。
examples.en: Whatever the difficulties and dangers, we will finish the job.

usage.en: Attributive or object; often 克服/战胜千难万险.
usage.zh: 作定语、宾语，常与“克服、战胜”搭配。

meaning.en: Having no equal anywhere in the world.
meaning.zh: 整个世界上找不到第二个，形容极其杰出。

examples.zh: 这座古塔的建筑艺术举世无双。
examples.en: The architecture of this ancient pagoda is unrivalled.

examples.zh: 他的书法举世无双。
examples.en: His calligraphy has no equal in the world.

meaning.en: Bold in action but careful in thought.
meaning.zh: 做事胆子大，考虑却很周密。

examples.zh: 好的外科医生要胆大心细。
examples.en: A good surgeon must be bold yet careful.

examples.zh: 这个任务需要胆大心细的人。
examples.en: This job needs someone bold and meticulous.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; often 胆大心细.

meaning.en: To judge or choose people by their looks.
meaning.zh: 根据外貌来判断、选取人。

examples.zh: 招聘不能以貌取人。
examples.en: Hiring should not be decided by looks.

examples.zh: 别以貌取人，他其实很有才华。
examples.en: Don't judge by appearances; he's actually very talented.

story.en: Confucius on his disciple Zi Yu: 'I judged him by his looks and was wrong about Zi Yu' (以貌取人，失之子羽).
story.zh: 《史记》：“孔子闻之，曰：‘以言取人乎，失之宰予；以貌取人乎，失之子羽。’”

usage.en: Predicate; often negated as 不可以貌取人.
usage.zh: 作谓语，常说“不可以貌取人”。

antonyms: 路遥知马力，日久见人心
人不可貌相，海水不可斗量

meaning.en: Saying or showing one thing outwardly but thinking another.
meaning.zh: 外表和内心不一致，言行与思想不一样。

equivalents: say one thing and mean another

examples.zh: 这个人表里不一，不可深交。
examples.en: The man is two-faced and not to be trusted.

examples.zh: 他对人热情，背后却说坏话，真是表里不一。
examples.en: He's warm to your face and badmouths you behind your back, a real hypocrite.

synonyms: 金漆马桶——外面光，里面臭
又想当婊子又想立牌坊
